xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2876: Conversation subagent rail: list spawned subagents and open their transcripts

plan.title: Conversation subagent rail: list spawned subagents and open their transcripts
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: When a dashboard conversation spawns Claude Code subagents via the Agent tool, the transcript shows only the collapsed 'Agent <description>' tool row — the subagent's actual work is invisible. Claude Code writes each subagent's transcript as a standalone JSONL (same schema as the parent) plus an agent-<id>.meta.json under <sessionFile minus .jsonl>/subagents/, so the existing parse/watch/stream pipeline can render them; only discovery, transport plumbing, and a rail UI are missing. Separately, the current harness writes the spawn tool as name 'Agent' but both renderers special-case only 'Task', so Agent rows fall through to a raw JSON dump.
narratives.Proposal: Server-side: a new async discovery module lists agent-<id>.meta.json entries; the existing pan.subscribeConversationMessages handler emits a new {kind:'subagents'} full-list event (initial + 2 s change-detecting poll, cleared on release) with status derived from the parent parse state's pendingToolUse map, and accepts an optional agentId payload to stream a subagent transcript through the unchanged parseEntireConversation/watchConversation/gateSnapshotEmission flow; REST GET /api/conversations/:name/messages gains ?agentId= and a subagents[] field for ended conversations. Frontend: the conversation body flex row gains a right-side SubagentRail (hidden when empty, ?subagent=<id> URL state) that renders a second read-only MessagesTimeline for the selected subagent; the inline Agent row links to its subagent via the toolUseId ⇔ tool_use block id join; and 'Agent' is handled identically to 'Task' in ToolUseExpanded and summarizeToolInputForWorkLog.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Pi/Codex subagent equivalents (no such file layout; those conversations never emit subagents events and never show the rail)
- Recursive/tree rails for nested subagents — spawnDepth > 1 renders flat with a depth marker only
- Any new state plane: no DB columns, no overdeck-state writes, no new resolver domains (JSONL/liveness plane reads only)
- A second subscription RPC (subscribeConversationSubagents is rejected; the existing subscription is extended)
- Delta/merge protocol for the subagent list (full-list replace events only)
- fs.watch on the subagents directory (2 s poll per PRD D-3)
- Composer/input on the subagent transcript view (read-only)
- Any write, delete, or truncate touching ~/.claude/projects/** transcripts or meta files

narrative.Action: Create src/dashboard/server/services/conversation/subagents.ts exporting subagentsDirFor(sessionFile) returning '<sessionFile minus .jsonl>/subagents', async listSubagentMetas(sessionFile) reading agent-<id>.meta.json files via fs/promises readdir/readFile (agentId derived from the filename; fields agentType, description, toolUseId, spawnDepth parsed from JSON; unparseable files skipped with console.warn; meta contents memoized by filename since meta files are write-once, so steady-state polling is readdir + set comparison only; absent or empty dir returns [] without throwing), and subagentTranscriptPath(sessionFile, agentId) returning the agent-<id>.jsonl path only when agentId matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/ AND path.resolve confirms the result stays inside the subagents dir, else null. narrative.Action: In the parent-stream branch of the subscribeConversationMessages handler, inside the existing Effect.acquireRelease acquire (after the initial snapshot offer at ws-rpc.ts:985-994): compute the initial list via listSubagentMetas, stamp each status as 'running' iff its toolUseId is in the parse state's pendingToolUse map else 'done' (PRD D-4/FR-3), and offer {kind:'subagents', subagents} — emit even when the list is empty so a resubscribing client clears stale state. Start a 2000 ms setInterval re-running scan + status stamp, offering only when the serialized list differs from the last emission; clear the interval in the same release that stops watchConversation (leaked intervals per subscription are the hazard). Also re-stamp statuses on each watchConversation delta since pendingToolUse changes arrive there first. Checkpoint CP-1 fallback is decided: if offer ordering relative to the first messages snapshot is awkward, emit the subagents event first — the client handles either order; do not redesign. Emission stays behind the claude-jsonl transcriptKind gate (PRD D-6). Tests MUST use vi.useFakeTimers() + advanceTimersByTimeAsync for the poll — never real waits, never maxForks:1 masking (standing fake-timers rule).
